findings.detail: Observed in source (processing_demand.py enqueue): a repeated key dedupes only while the existing demand is pending/running/failed; a completed or terminal_failed demand with the same key is enqueued as a fresh demand. This is consistent with the C1 'repeated key returns the existing demand' reading for active work and lets a re-request after terminal completion create new work. Not a defect; recorded for downstream consumers (ZR-508 / filing-fetch) to rely on.
